addedProviders.name: Idaho Fish and Game Teton Dam site access area
addedProviders.method: IDFG confirms a named Teton Dam boating-access facility, while BLM/USBR materials describe multiple informal trails and take-outs around the former dam. The retained route point is a legacy old-dam access-area anchor, not the IDFG facility-map marker or a surveyed water entry; keep the ~0.3 mi discrepancy visible and require field confirmation of the actual gated-road carry and lawful launch.

controls.name: Teton Dam access corridor / carry-in
controls.coordinateText: Legacy route point retained as a generalized former-dam access-area anchor; IDFG current facility map marks a separate point about 0.3 mi north; field verification required.

addedProviders.name: Wisconsin DNR and Wisconsin River Trips Germania Marsh access
addedProviders.method: Wisconsin River Trips identifies a public ramp just north of Germania Marsh Dam at the south end of the route; Wisconsin DNR confirms non-motorized boating/canoeing in Germania Marsh Wildlife Area. The stored point is a site-area anchor, not a surveyed ramp toe, and the main ramp may be seasonal; confirm gates and access before launch.

controls.name: Germania Marsh Dam public access area
controls.coordinateText: Stored route access-area point; operator describes a public ramp north of the dam but publishes no GPS for the ramp toe.

addedProviders.name: Montana FWP Bell Crossing Fishing Access Site
addedProviders.method: Montana FWP identifies Bell Crossing FAS and its GIS record (LMS_ID 39754137 / OBJECTID 158) specifies a gravel ramp at x=-114.1263060, y=46.4443416. The route point matches FWP’s published five-decimal latitude/longitude; treat it as the access-site anchor, not the surveyed waterline toe.

controls.name: Bell Crossing Fishing Access Site
controls.coordinateText: Stored point rounds to Montana FWP public site coordinates; GIS feature 158 / LMS_ID 39754137 identifies a gravel ramp.

addedProviders.name: Wallkill River Watershed Alliance and Orange County Gardiner launch access area
addedProviders.method: The Wallkill River Watershed Alliance inventory lists Gardiner Launch at 215 Farmer’s Turnpike as active, and Orange County maps the Gardiner launch within the Wallkill water-trail section. The stored coordinate is a generalized location matched to the mapped/address point; no current municipal GPS or surveyed water-entry coordinate was located. Reconfirm the Town’s current parking and carry rules.

controls.name: Gardiner Wallkill River launch access area
controls.coordinateText: Address/map matched access-area anchor for the listed active launch at 215 Farmer’s Turnpike; exact water entry and current Town rules are not published.

addedProviders.name: Texas Parks and Wildlife Buffalo Bayou Paddling Trail access points
addedProviders.method: TPWD’s current Buffalo Bayou Paddling Trail page lists Woodway Memorial Park as a public access point and publishes 29.7647,-95.4569. The coordinate is retained as the park/access anchor; bank conditions and exact carry can change with erosion and water level, so do not describe it as a surveyed water-entry toe.

controls.name: Woodway Memorial Park public access
controls.coordinateText: Coordinate published by TPWD for the named public paddling-trail access point; retained as a park/access anchor.

addedProviders.name: City of Raleigh Falls Dam public paddlecraft launch
addedProviders.method: Raleigh currently identifies Falls Dam as a public launch for nonmotorized paddlecraft and directs users to a gravel access road on the right before crossing the Neuse River. The Corps Tailrace Fishing Area parking lot is a distinct access on the left. The stored coordinate is retained from an older local paddling map as a generalized access-area anchor; Raleigh does not publish a GPS point or surveyed water-entry coordinate.

controls.name: Falls Dam public paddlecraft launch access area
aliases: Neuse River Greenway and Canoe Launch
controls.coordinateText: Legacy local map access-area coordinate; Raleigh’s current route page confirms launch directions but publishes no GPS. Do not confuse with the separate USACE Tailrace Fishing Area lot.

addedProviders.name: Turner Bend private-fee landing
addedProviders.method: Turner Bend’s operator identifies its landing at the Highway 23 / Mulberry River corridor and describes it as load/unload access for private boaters subject to an access wristband, parking permission, and shuttle/loading rules. The route coordinate is a bridge-corridor/access-area anchor, not a surveyed landing toe; access is conditional on current operator terms and fees.

controls.name: Turner Bend private-fee landing access area
controls.coordinateText: Highway 23 corridor point retained as access-area anchor; operator requires current wristband and loading/parking permission.

correctedProviderRoles.reason: Both stored points are generalized/address-matched launch-area anchors, not defensible water-entry coordinates.
